entries.name: Bilt
entries.what: Rent rewards and points platform that runs frequent points promos and airline partner offers.
entries.why_fit: Its rent focused rewards model and airline tie ins are a live benchmark for engagement and benefit design that appeals to affluent renters.

history.note: Bilt Rent Day offers up to a 100% bonus on points redeemed for statement credits (normally 0.55 cents per point) and a JetBlue Mosaic status match.

entries.name: Etihad
entries.what: Abu Dhabi based premium airline with its own loyalty program.
entries.why_fit: A foreign premium airline entering the US card market is a possible co-brand or benefit partner and a new high fee competitor for affluent cardholders.

history.note: Reported as launching its first credit cards in the US market. The item does not say who the issuer is, so check that before treating it as a competitor win.

entries.name: Atmos Rewards
entries.what: Combined Alaska and Hawaiian airline loyalty program with its own premium co-brand cards.
entries.why_fit: A major West Coast airline currency that issuers are actively paying to acquire members for, relevant to any airline benefit or transfer play.

history.note: Bank of America targeted offers rose to 125k points on the Atmos Summit and 90k on the Atmos Ascent. Atmos also has a double points promo on Hawaii flights through March 10, 2027.

entries.name: Rove
entries.what: Loyalty program that has launched personalized shopping offers with in store earning.
entries.why_fit: A loyalty currency with offer based earning could work as an offer or transfer partner for card benefits.

history.note: Launched personalized shopping offers earning up to 25 miles per dollar and expanded in store earning.

entries.name: NetJets
entries.why_fit: Private flying and premier sporting event access match what HNW and UHNW cardholders value, and could support a concierge or flight benefit.

history.note: Named official private aviation provider of the Hahnenkamm Races in Kitzbühel. This is an event sponsorship, not an issuer deal.
